items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Broussard had his band up in the front... I understood Anderson and Broussard.

ctx.x: And how long do you have in between numbers? They give you any time between numbers?

Well yeah, like the Lions Club used these two bands, see, where Broussard had his band up in the front, see, right behind some of the marches, you know. Roussard, Oscar Roussard. Yeah, he had his brass band. The Alphablan, yeah. Yeah. See, he was right behind a long column of, oh, they have a large club that lines. He was right behind some, then some old marches behind him, and then Anderson Band behind them, and then behind us, the remaining of the marches, see. Well, you would one band play a number, see, and…
So that gave you a little right.
